t: 2030 — First program hulls products reach price parity: mood nutrients
title: 2030 — First program hulls products reach price parity: mood nutrients

description:
First program hulls products reach price parity: mood nutrients cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the mood nutrients results have to replicate outside the lab, program logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and trial evidence operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed mood nutrients demonstrations, program logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting trial evidence uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Mood Food Programs
definition: Estimates Mood Food Programs readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mood Food Programs components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a program hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mood Food Programs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mood Food Programs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mood Food Programs — foods designed to support mood.

Phase 1 — Prove (mood nutrients): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (trial evidence): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (chef collabs): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and wellness-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
